summary.goal: Provide Cmd+K command palette for quick plan navigation without leaving keyboard.
summary.context: Power users expect Cmd+K for fast navigation (VSCode, Slack, Linear, etc.). Searches plans by goal, filters by status/scope, and shows recent plans. Optional enhancement that improves efficiency but isn't required for MVP.

acceptance_criteria.description: Cmd+K (Mac) / Ctrl+K (Windows) opens command palette from anywhere in app
Search matches plan goals with fuzzy matching
Results show plan goal, status badge, and scope
Recent plans shown before search results
Enter navigates to selected plan
Escape closes palette
Arrow keys navigate results

views.name: Command Palette
views.layout: Centered modal at 15vh from top, max-w-lg (560px), bg-bg-secondary with border-border-subtle, rounded-xl shadow-modal

elements.use: Search field with keyboard icon hint

elements.props: bg-bg-tertiary border-border-default rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-text-muted

elements.use: Plan row with goal, status, scope
elements.props: flex items-center gap-3 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg, selected state: bg-accent-cyan/10 border-accent-cyan/30
text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted uppercase tracking-wider py-2 px-3

states.empty: Shows recent plans if available, otherwise 'No plans found' centered with text-text-muted
states.searching: Shows live results as user types, results replace recent section
states.no_results: Shows 'No plans match' with suggestion to create new
states.selected: Current selection has bg-accent-cyan/10 with subtle border highlight

steps.title: Install fuse.js for fuzzy search
steps.description: Add fuse.js dependency for fuzzy matching. This is a lightweight (~5kb gzipped) fuzzy search library used by many command palettes.

acceptance_criteria.description: fuse.js added to package.json dependencies
TypeScript types available (@types/fuse.js or built-in)

testing.rationale: Command palette is a power-user feature. Unit tests for hooks provide confidence in logic. Integration tests verify keyboard behavior. One E2E test confirms full flow. Skip visual/styling tests.
skip_rationale: Visual styling tests (CSS classes) - verified manually, low regression risk
Exact positioning tests - layout is not critical to functionality
Performance tests for fuzzy search - fuse.js is battle-tested
Accessibility tests - should be added if this becomes high-traffic feature

custom_components: CommandPalette - modal with keyboard handling, focus trap, and backdrop
useCommandPalette - hook for global keyboard shortcut and open state
useFuzzySearch - hook wrapping fuse.js for plan search
useRecentPlans - hook for localStorage-backed recent plan tracking

steps.title: Create useCommandPalette hook for global keyboard shortcut
steps.description: React hook that manages command palette open/close state and listens for Cmd+K (Mac) / Ctrl+K (Windows/Linux) globally. Returns { isOpen, open, close, toggle }.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hook returns { isOpen: boolean, open: () => void, close: () => void, toggle: () => void }
Cmd+K opens palette on Mac (e.metaKey && e.key === 'k')
Ctrl+K opens palette on Windows/Linux (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'k')
Event listener registered on mount, cleaned up on unmount
Prevents default browser behavior (Ctrl+K focuses address bar in some browsers)

steps.title: Create useFuzzySearch hook wrapping fuse.js
steps.description: Hook that takes plan list and search query, returns ranked fuzzy-matched results. Configure fuse.js to search plan.summary.goal field with reasonable threshold.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hook signature: useFuzzySearch(plans: Plan[], query: string) => Plan[]
Searches plan.summary.goal field
Returns empty array when query is empty (allows showing recent plans instead)
Results ranked by fuse.js score (best match first)
Threshold configured for reasonable typo tolerance (~0.4)
Fuse instance memoized to avoid recreation on every render

steps.title: Create useRecentPlans hook for localStorage tracking
steps.description: Hook that tracks recently viewed plans in localStorage. Stores up to 5 plan IDs, provides methods to add and retrieve. Used to show recent plans when palette opens with empty query.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hook returns { recentPlanIds: string[], addRecent: (planId: string) => void }
Stores in localStorage key 'planner:recentPlans'
Maintains max 5 entries (LRU - most recent first)
Adding existing ID moves it to front (no duplicates)
Gracefully handles localStorage unavailable (returns empty array)

steps.title: Create CommandPalette component
steps.description: Modal component following relay-dashboard patterns: fixed inset-0 backdrop, centered dialog at 15vh from top, search input with keyboard hints, scrollable results list. Handles keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter, Escape). Uses design system colors/spacing.

acceptance_criteria.description: Renders as fixed overlay with bg-black/60 backdrop
Dialog positioned 15vh from top, max-w-[560px], max-h-[60vh]
Uses design system: bg-bg-secondary, border-border-subtle, rounded-xl, shadow-modal
Search input autofocuses on open, styled with bg-transparent text-text-primary
ESC keyboard hint shown in header (bg-bg-tertiary border-border-default)
Escape key closes palette
Click on backdrop closes palette
Arrow up/down moves selection through results
Enter navigates to selected plan (using react-router navigate)
Selection wraps at boundaries (down from last goes to first)
Selected item has bg-accent-cyan/10 with border-accent-cyan/30
Results show: plan goal (truncated), status badge, scopes
Empty query shows Recent Plans section (from useRecentPlans)
With query shows Search Results section (from useFuzzySearch)
No results shows 'No plans match [query]' message

steps.title: Create PlanResultItem component
steps.description: Individual result row for command palette. Shows plan goal (truncated), status badge matching existing StatusBadge style, and scope tags. Hover and selected states.

acceptance_criteria.description: Displays plan.summary.goal truncated to ~60 chars with ellipsis
Shows status badge (draft/approved/published) using existing color scheme
Shows first scope if plan has scopes, styled as subtle tag
Hover state: bg-bg-hover transition-colors
Selected prop adds bg-accent-cyan/10 border-accent-cyan/30
Forwards ref for scroll-into-view behavior

steps.title: Integrate CommandPalette into Layout
steps.description: Add CommandPalette to Layout component (rendered on all pages). Wire up useCommandPalette hook for global open/close. Fetch plans list for search.

acceptance_criteria.description: CommandPalette rendered inside Layout component
useCommandPalette hook provides isOpen state to CommandPalette
Plans fetched on palette open (not on page load to avoid unnecessary requests)
Loading state shown while plans are fetching
Cmd+K works from any page in the app

steps.title: Track plan views for recent plans
steps.description: Call useRecentPlans.addRecent when viewing a plan in PlanEditorPage. This populates the recent plans list shown in command palette.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanEditorPage calls addRecent(planId) on mount
Recent plans appear in command palette when opened with empty query
Recent list updates when navigating between plans

steps.title: [assert] Command palette modal appears centered on screen
[assert] Search input is focused with cursor ready
[assert] Recent plans section shows previously viewed plans (if any)
[assert] Results update live as user types, showing matching plans
[assert] Selection moves to next result with visual highlight
[assert] Palette closes and plan editor page loads
[assert] Recent plans now includes the just-viewed plan at top

cases.description: Cmd+K toggles isOpen state and prevents default
Ctrl+K toggles isOpen on non-Mac platforms
Returns matching plans for partial query (e.g., 'auth' matches 'Authentication feature')
Returns empty array for empty query
Handles typos within threshold (e.g., 'authetication' still matches)
addRecent stores plan ID and retrieves it
Adding existing ID moves it to front (no duplicates)
Returns empty array when localStorage unavailable
Arrow down moves selection to next result
Arrow up moves selection to previous result
Selection wraps from last to first (and vice versa)
Enter on selected result calls navigate with plan URL
Full flow: Cmd+K -> type query -> arrow down -> Enter -> navigates to plan -> Cmd+K -> recent shows plan

data_requirements: 3+ mock plans with distinct goals for search testing
Plan goals should include: 'Authentication feature', 'Payment processing', 'User settings'
Mock react-router navigate function for navigation tests
